name: wallets
title: Wallets
summary: Link EVM wallets to an account (Sign-In with Ethereum or Privy embedded), see token balances and incoming and outgoing transfers.

env.name: WALLETS_CHAINS
env.doc: JSON array of chains: [{id, name, rpc_url, public_rpc_url?, explorer_url?, native_symbol?, native_decimals?, testnet?, tokens: [{address, symbol, name?, decimals}]}]. decimals is a digit count (6 for USDC). Empty = no chains.
env.source: Chain ids from chainlist.org; rpc_url from your RPC provider (Alchemy, Infura, QuickNode); token decimals from the contract's decimals().

env.name: WALLETS_DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID
env.doc: Chain clients pick first and SIWE challenges default to. Empty = the first chain in WALLETS_CHAINS.

env.name: WALLETS_SIWE_URI
env.doc: Origin named in Sign-In with Ethereum messages (domain and URI). Empty = PUBLIC_WEB_URL. https in production.

env.name: WALLETS_MAX_PER_USER
env.doc: Most wallets one account can link.

env.name: WALLETS_RPC_TIMEOUT
env.doc: Timeout for one chain's JSON-RPC round trip (balances, EIP-1271 checks).

env.name: WALLETS_BALANCE_CACHE_TTL
env.doc: How long a balance read is reused before the RPC is asked again.

env.name: WALLETS_INDEXER_SECRET
env.doc: HMAC-SHA256 key the indexer signs POST /webhooks/wallets/indexer with (X-Signature). Empty = the webhook answers 503.
env.source: Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` and give the same value to the indexer.

env.name: PRIVY_APP_ID
env.doc: Privy app id. Set with PRIVY_VERIFICATION_KEY to enable embedded wallets; empty = embedded wallets off (503).

env.name: PRIVY_VERIFICATION_KEY
env.doc: Privy ES256 verification key (PEM; literal \n escapes allowed) used to verify identity tokens locally. A public key, not the app secret.
env.source: Privy dashboard → App settings → Basics → Verification key.

env.name: WALLETS_LOCAL_CHAIN
env.doc: true: dev-up starts Anvil (Foundry) in the project's port block and points WALLETS_CHAINS at it. Needs `anvil` on PATH.

env.name: WALLETS_LOCAL_CHAIN_ID
env.doc: Chain id of the local Anvil chain.

wire.insert: import { walletsAdminNav, walletsHomeTile, walletsNav, walletsSettings } from "./wallets/nav";

stitch: Set WALLETS_CHAINS (and WALLETS_DEFAULT_CHAIN_ID) per environment; RPC URLs live in the secret store. With no chains every screen says wallets aren't set up.
Point an indexer (Ponder, Goldsky, Alchemy webhooks through a relay) at POST /webhooks/wallets/indexer with WALLETS_INDEXER_SECRET, watching the tokens in WALLETS_CHAINS (contract in FEATURE.md).
Decide where wallets live: the Wallet nav entry and Home tile are wired by default; remove them from the registries if wallets are secondary.
If the notifications feature is installed, register the wallets.received kind (FEATURE.md, Stitching).
Mobile links wallets through the web page (link_url) until you add WalletConnect or Privy embedded wallets (FEATURE.md, Stitching).
Embedded wallets: set PRIVY_APP_ID and PRIVY_VERIFICATION_KEY, add the Privy SDK to the clients, and name Privy in the privacy policy.
